Tests that cost is tracked after a successful response

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
let _client = try createClientFromJson(json: "{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"budget\":{\"enforcement\":\"hard\",\"global_limit\":50.0},\"cost_tracking\":true}")
let result = try await _client.chat(_req)
print(result)
```
